title: Reconciliation check: California Waymo mileage, CPUC vs. Waymo's own S2 benchmark
purpose: Both figures below independently describe 'how many miles has Waymo driven in California,' reported through two different channels. This is published as a transparency check, not a claim that the numbers should match -- see caveats.
cpuc_side_source: CPUC AV Program deployment reports, Waymo Driverless Deployment, California
cpuc_side_note: Sum of VMT Period 1+2+3 across all CPUC-reported months currently ingested for Waymo's Driverless Deployment program. Known gaps exist (see Activity page) -- this is NOT a complete monthly series, so it understates true cumulative VMT over the same period.
waymo_s2_side_source: Waymo self-published S2-cell safety benchmark data, California, latest vintage
waymo_s2_side_note: Cumulative 'RO miles' (revenue/operations miles) for California as of this vintage's reporting window. Scope (e.g. whether Pilot-program or non-passenger miles are included) is not documented in the source file.
caveats: ["Different accounting windows: CPUC is a sum of specific reported months (with gaps); Waymo S2 is a cumulative total through a vintage's end date.","Different scope: CPUC's figure is Driverless Deployment program VMT only; Waymo S2's 'RO miles' scope is not documented and may be broader (e.g. include Pilot/drivered miles).","Different VMT definitions: CPUC's VMT Period 1/2/3 categories are CPUC's own reporting-template definitions, not independently confirmed against Waymo S2's 'RO miles' definition in the sources ingested so far.","A large gap between these numbers is expected given the above, not evidence of a data error in either source."]
